decision.summary: A transient multi-axis offset begins at index 440 with sharp rises in N and E (~+4–5 MAD), followed by a rapid descent starting ~465; U lags and peaks later (~465) with smaller amplitude. All axes show partial recovery by index 474, but none have fully returned to pre-event levels within the allowed context [405,510]. The return is ongoing and asymmetric across axes, so status is uncertain.
